title: The age of snarky UI
partialText: Your devices are all judging you. They're just too polite to say it directly.

title: AI in Focus: A new Claude Skill for Rails code audits
partialText: Learn what happened when Chad installed the open source rails-audit-thoughtbot Claude skill, ran it on thoughtbot's decade-old internal Hub app, and walked through hits, misses, and how we'd tighten the skill over time.

title: You, too, can make a boilerplate
partialText: Adapt your own patterns and processes into a reusable piece of content.

title: Sixty-six commits and the commands that didn't survive
partialText: In week two of building a management system with Claude Code, I created fifteen commands in a day. By the end of the week, I'd deleted three of them.
